name: PCC Technology Group
why: I found the business but it no longer has a site of its own, and recording one would file a parent's facts under this record. pcctechnologyinc.com resolves but 301s to gocivix.com, and every page there is branded Civix - identity_note on the Civix homepage is ok=False, present=[], missing=['pcc','technology','group']. The Civix about page (gocivix.com/company/about-civix/) explains why, in its own timeline: '2015-2016: Quest Information Systems (Quest) and PCC technology Inc. (PCC) were acquired to expand elections, government business service, and campaign finance offerings'. So PCC was absorbed into Civix (a GCR/HKW portfolio company). The business does match our description - Civix's Go Elect voter registration page says 'used by more states than any other to ensure the integrity of voter and election-related data' and Go Register covers business registry - but the only page naming PCC names it as an acquisition, in the past tense. Writing https://gocivix.com here would point the logo fetcher and board discovery at Civix and attribute Civix's postings to PCC, which is the parent-subsidiary error the admin's Acquisitions queue exists to catch. Recommend routing this to merge/acquisitions with also_known_as='Civix' rather than giving it a website.

name: Vocalis
why: I reached four Vocalis domains and none of them is the public-safety company. vocalis.io PASSES identifies() (ok=True, present=['vocalis'], domain_is_lead=True) and is a real, live, well-built AI voice product - but it sells to health insurers: 'The phone is still how members reach your health plan. Vocalis answers with an AI that knows your plans', and its sample call is about claim #4821. Zero occurrences of 911, public safety, dispatch, police or emergency in the whole page. vocalis.net is the known dead Croatian VoIP mirror already cleared by hand. vocalis.co and getvocalis.com do not answer. Search also surfaces vocalis-ai.org (emotional AI voice assistant) and vocalis.pro (B2B sales AI agents), neither public safety, and no source ties any Vocalis to IACP or to a PSAP product. So vocalis.io is a second trap of exactly the vocalis.net shape - it would sail past the identity check and be wrong. This record keeps its blank.
